title: The Verdant Watercourt
theme: Overgrown ruined temple water garden with reversed flow, hidden culverts, and a restless shrine custodian
hook: A moonlit spring has begun flowing backward through an overgrown temple court. The village asks the party to recover the old water seal before the channels flood the lower road.
background: The Verdant Watercourt once kept the lower road dry by binding spring water into a sequence of shrine channels. Now the flow has reversed, dragging silt uphill, flooding old garden walks, and waking a custodian bound to protect the court from theft. The party must recover the missing bronze water seal, learn where it belongs, and restore the high apse before the channels burst into the village road.

rooms.name: South Garden Gate
rooms.readAloud: Broken steps climb from flowering undergrowth into a roofless court. Water murmurs somewhere beyond the ruined wall.
rooms.gmNotes: This is the safest entry point. Tracks show someone dragged a heavy bronze object north toward the bridge walk.
rooms.treasure: A mossy column base hides three old votive coins.
rooms.secrets: A vine-covered wall niche contains a chipped map tile showing the under-pool culvert.
rooms.exits: North along the broken processional walk to Room 7, or up the old west garden path to Room 3.

rooms.name: Compass Watercourt
rooms.readAloud: A broad tiled court opens around a circular inlay. Water channels glitter on either side of the old shrine floor.
rooms.gmNotes: The central compass inlay points toward the correct offering if water is poured into its grooves.

inhabitants.name: Court-Wake Echo
inhabitants.tactics: Repeats old commands, seals side paths with brief curtains of water, tests respectful behavior
inhabitants.morale: Quiets if the court is cleaned or addressed by its old title
inhabitants.wants: The water seal returned to the high apse
inhabitants.leverage: Responds to offerings of clean water, repaired tiles, or truthful names

rooms.treasure: A loose compass tile is inlaid with silver leaf.
rooms.secrets: The inlay marks the submerged culvert from Room 3 to Room 6 if read from the north stair.
rooms.exits: South to Room 7, north stair to Room 4, west bridge to Room 3, and east walk to Room 5.

rooms.name: North Stair Of Falling Leaves
rooms.readAloud: A long stair climbs between mossy walls toward the forest canopy. Fallen leaves drift downward though there is no wind.
rooms.gmNotes: The stair is a pressure release for the watercourt; blocking it makes water rise in Room 2.
rooms.treasure: A leaf-shaped bronze pressure key rests beneath the third cracked step.
rooms.secrets: The leaves fall toward whichever chamber currently holds the water seal.

rooms.name: Eastern Lily Channel
rooms.readAloud: A narrow stone walk skirts bright water. Lily pads turn slowly against the current, as if something below is breathing.
rooms.gmNotes: The water is not deep, but the slick stones can dump careless explorers into a fast undercurrent.

inhabitants.name: Lily-Channel Grasper
inhabitants.tactics: Tugs ankles from water, retreats beneath broken masonry, targets isolated explorers
inhabitants.morale: Withdraws if fed bright metal or driven from the water
inhabitants.leverage: Can be distracted with coins, bells, or a held lantern reflection

rooms.treasure: A bronze water-bowl lies wedged between channel stones.
rooms.secrets: The current flows toward the hidden culvert exit near Room 6.
rooms.exits: West to Room 2, north to Room 8, and south along the water walk to Room 6.

rooms.name: Scribes' Lower Rooms
rooms.readAloud: Two dry chambers hold stone writing desks, toppled stools, and a wall of pots stained with old blue pigment.
rooms.gmNotes: The scribes recorded flood levels. Their final mark warns that opening the high apse without the seal wakes the pool.
rooms.treasure: A sealed pigment jar, a gold-tipped reed pen, and the missing bronze water seal.
rooms.secrets: The submerged culvert from Room 3 exits behind the lower writing desk.
rooms.exits: North along the water walk to Room 5, or hidden submerged culvert to Room 3.

rooms.name: Broken Processional Walk
rooms.readAloud: A straight bridge of pale stone crosses between two dark pools. The center stones are cracked but still passable.
rooms.gmNotes: The bridge is the obvious route into the court. Heavy fighting here risks knocking someone into the pool.
rooms.treasure: A pilgrim token shines below the bridge in shallow water.
rooms.secrets: Reflections in the left pool briefly show the high apse before its collapse.
rooms.exits: South to Room 1 and north to Room 2.

rooms.name: High Apse Of Green Water
rooms.readAloud: An upper shrine chamber rises beyond mossy steps. A round altar stands in green light, ringed by bowls and broken benches.
rooms.gmNotes: The water seal belongs in the altar basin. Without it, the altar calls the pool guardian into the court.

inhabitants.name: Greenwater Custodian
inhabitants.tactics: Commands water, pins intruders near the steps, pauses for anyone carrying the seal respectfully
inhabitants.morale: Stands down if the seal is restored and no shrine vessels are stolen
inhabitants.wants: The watercourt made whole and the lower road spared from flood
inhabitants.leverage: Can be appeased with the seal, cleaned bowls, and returned votive coins

rooms.treasure: The restored altar grants a blessing of clean water and reveals a hidden scholarship fund in the scribe rooms.
rooms.secrets: The custodian is bound to protect the road below, not the shrine treasure.

wandering.result: A curtain of water rises across one visible bridge
A shrine echo asks for the old name of the court

The lily-channel grasper stirs below a bridge

environmental.result: Water runs backward for a minute, revealing submerged steps
A slick bridge stone threatens to drop gear into a pool
Sunlight turns the central compass lines bright gold
Flower petals collect around the nearest hidden route
The high apse bell rings softly under the water
Roots tighten around a stolen shrine object

complications.result: A bridge route becomes slippery after water surges
A harmless echo repeats the party's private plan aloud
The custodian sends a warning ripple through every pool
A relic-hunter flees toward the wrong chamber with the seal
The hidden culvert begins to flood and becomes harder to use
A returned offering briefly calms every hazard in the court

Gold-tipped reed pen and sealed blue pigment jar

gmNotes: Use the visible routes, rooms, water channels, and bridges as the play surface; the shrine is open enough that sound and movement carry across the court.
Normal route overlays are disabled on the premium map because the art already shows the paths.
The secret route is the only route overlay because the submerged culvert is not obvious in the art.
The goal is to restore the water seal, not loot every reliquary vessel.
